comment:
Indeed a strange year! 

Recent technological moves are just phenomenal if used justly. Since everyone will have their own criteria for what "just" is, specially when it comes to nuances and not grand theories.. it is very hard to say "choose this one" or "the other one". Only real feedback I will share is, buckets is a life line for those of us who are trying to understand and reconcile realities of life. Every tech product is being almost taken over by almighty AI but to me personally it all feels like 'noise'. Keep buckets true to it's purpose, it doesn't need to do grand performances, all it needs to do is help that random guy on the internet who is trying to figure out, how do I survive this month and eventually to have space to think about budgeting. I've been on the both ends of this spectrum and all I can share is, thank you from the bottom of my heart for all the hard work (blood, sweat & tears) that you must have put in this product.

While I've got to know the product, the producers and the thinking behind it through these blog articles; over the years I've also come to appreciate how simple it is to use (remembering old videos of tutorial still give me chuckle) 

Keep on making it better but also keep it simple. 

PS: this product, it's your baby - raise it how ever you see fit but do monitor what it's getting exposed to :) 

PPS: so sorry for such a long write-up. it's been awhile I wanted to connect and this article drop seem like a good time to do just that. Cheers mate! have a good one.. and Namaste from a very small corner of this huge planet!
